description: Reply inside an existing thread and return the created message. Sent from the inbox that received the original, to the original sender (or to everyone on the thread with reply_all), with the subject and In-Reply-To/References headers set so mail clients thread it correctly. Block rules and suppression apply. Errors: 404 unknown message, 402 plan send limit reached.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments, same shape as send_message.

content_type.description: MIME type; inferred from filename when omitted.

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient.

html.description: Optional HTML body of the reply.

message_id.description: Id of the message to reply to (from search_messages, get_thread or a webhook event).

reply_all.description: Reply to every original recipient (To and CC) instead of only the sender. Default false.

name: reply_to_message
title: Reply to email
